motion.name: landing-master-timeline
motion.value: Paused Anime.js timeline; five 1000ms chapter windows; staggered inOut(3) part translations; linear signal travel; damping 1 - exp(-delta * 10), delta capped at 0.05s
motion.purpose: The same four source modules and evidence hub unfold into a map, form Code/Build/Tests/Production/Evidence connections, open the evidence housing into four quadrants, retrace the path and reassemble into original slots before covers close. Orientation is fixed during open chapters; only opening, closing and manual input tilt the object. Rendering pauses at rest, outside the story and in hidden tabs; DPR caps remain 1.6 desktop and 1.25 mobile.

motion.name: landing-core-rotation
motion.value: Drag x delta * 0.008 and y delta * 0.006; x clamp -1.8..1.8 and y clamp -0.55..0.55 radians; Left/Right increment 0.2; Home or Reset clears both
motion.purpose: Labeled direct rotation; Home or the Reset core rotation button in the story scrubber toolbar clears manual orientation. Chapter hover/focus and tool selection emphasize module faces. Source logos stay attached during open chapters; captions clear the projected rim by 8px.

motion.name: landing-workflow-playback
motion.value: User-initiated Anime.js animation; 2400ms; linear; four selected steps
motion.purpose: Illustrative forward delivery and reverse investigation update tool explanations. The play button disables during playback; reduced motion selects the terminal step.

motion.name: landing-static-fallback
motion.value: Static five-layer SVG mechanism; reduced motion skips WebGL initialization
motion.purpose: No JavaScript, unavailable WebGL, shader failure and context loss retain the SVG with independent HTML and native anchors. Context restoration resumes rendering; preference changes and unmount dispose scene resources and timelines.

narrative.overview:
Forge uses neutral charcoal surfaces, fine gray rules, compact controls, and readable operational detail. The approved dark developer-tool brief is the visual authority. Color communicates state; typography and spacing establish hierarchy.

This document records the implemented Phase 1 foundation in `apps/web`: the overview at `/app`, system status, and setup guide. Authentication, integrations, metrics, charts, and form fields are not implemented and have no established application component conventions here.

The public landing page at `/` adds a built precision mechanism: four source modules and an evidence hub on a white canvas, large black Geist type, and reversible Anime.js transformations. Colored module faces preserve identity while the surrounding page stays monochrome. Machined materials, a custom GLSL connection signal, direct rotation and attached integration logos belong to this marketing surface. The application retains the compact, flat, neutral conventions below. The simple wordmark remains in use; a new 3D logo is deferred.
keyCharacteristics: Flat charcoal surfaces with subtle borders.
Geist interface text with system monospace for commands and versions.
Restrained controls and explicit, text-supported service states.
Responsive navigation and locally scrollable technical content.
A scoped public landing with four persistent source modules, an evidence hub, and five transformation chapters.

rules.name: The Evidence Rule
rules.body: Use state colors with a label and icon. An unverified or loading check must remain visually distinct from a healthy check.

dos: **Do** use subtle borders and tonal separation for operational surfaces.
**Do** pair state color with explicit text and an icon.
**Do** preserve unknown, checking, unavailable, and healthy as distinct states.
**Do** keep mobile technical content locally scrollable with a visible cue when needed.
**Do** use real navigation targets and neutral descriptions of health checks.
**Do** scope the monochrome page palette, colored mechanism, display typography, shader materials, and core transformations to the public marketing surface.
**Do** keep the static mechanism, chapter content, and native navigation available with reduced motion, JavaScript disabled, or unavailable WebGL.
donts: **Don't** fabricate metrics, customer data, connected sources, or working planned controls.
**Don't** replace the restrained application foundation with the landing's material gradients, depth, or oversized display text.
**Don't** treat a healthy installation as evidence that an engineering source is connected.
**Don't** document future forms, charts, or authentication screens as implemented patterns.
